purpose: Select the exact raster references that are authoritative for future reference-first vectorization.
principle: The selected raster reference is the visual authority. Future vector work must reproduce it faithfully and must not creatively reinterpret shape, spacing, color, typography or proportions.

source_context.origin: AI-generated visual references created in a separate conversation and selected by human review.
source_context.current_repository_state: Reference images are not yet committed as binary assets in the repository.
source_context.required_next_input: Commit or otherwise provide the exact reference raster files before any new SVG/vector candidate is created.

primary_symbol.role: Authoritative source for the standalone gold pen/drop symbol.
primary_symbol.expected_source: Dark-background image containing only the gold pen/drop symbol.
must_preserve: visual weight and gold tone from source

light_logo_lockup.role: Authoritative source for the light-background ARTales logo lockup.
light_logo_lockup.expected_source: Warm paper-background image with gold symbol and dark ARTales wordmark.
must_preserve: gold symbol color as sampled from the source
dark wordmark color as sampled from the source
warm paper background only for comparison, not as the master background

dark_logo_lockup.role: Authoritative source for the dark-background ARTales logo lockup.
dark_logo_lockup.expected_source: Dark-background image with gold symbol and gold ARTales wordmark.
must_preserve: gold symbol and wordmark color as sampled from the source
dark background only for comparison, not as the master background

derived_review_outputs: sampled color swatches from source pixels
forbidden: new SVG drawn from memory or description
font substitution presented as final wordmark

next_valid_step: Add exact reference raster assets and a comparison-board workflow. Do not add replacement SVG masters until source images are present and comparisons can be reviewed.
